COMPUTATION / GUIDED READING
STAGE 01 / 10统一朝向、物理间隔、HU 范围和空间尺寸。XYZ 与 PyTorch 的 DHW 顺序要区分；发布配置把 XYZ 尺寸反转后交给视觉塔，预处理后的间隔不能由张量尺寸直接推断。Standardize orientation, physical spacing, HU range and spatial size. Distinguish XYZ from PyTorch DHW: the release reverses XYZ image dimensions before building the vision tower, and tensor size alone does not establish voxel spacing.
01
体数据标准化Volume standardization
统一朝向、物理间隔、HU 范围和空间尺寸。XYZ 与 PyTorch 的 DHW 顺序要区分；发布配置把 XYZ 尺寸反转后交给视觉塔，预处理后的间隔不能由张量尺寸直接推断。Standardize orientation, physical spacing, HU range and spatial size. Distinguish XYZ from PyTorch DHW: the release reverses XYZ image dimensions before building the vision tower, and tensor size alone does not establish voxel spacing.
02
三维卷积分块3D convolutional patches
以空间 XYZ 的 16×16×8 体素为块；实现的 DHW 核与步长为 8×16×16。128×352×352 输入得到 16×22×22=7744 个区域标记，三维卷积将每块映射为 Transformer 特征。Use XYZ patches of 16×16×8 voxels, implemented with DHW kernel and stride 8×16×16. A 128×352×352 volume yields a 16×22×22 grid, or 7,744 regional tokens, projected into Transformer features by a 3D convolution.
03
位置编码与全局标记Position encoding and global token
为区域标记加入三维空间位置，前置一个 CLS 全局标记。固定代码对 AugReg 位置编码进行空间适配；完整序列包含 7744 个区域标记与 1 个全局标记。Add 3D spatial position information and prepend a CLS token. The pinned implementation adapts AugReg position embeddings; the full sequence contains 7,744 regional tokens and one global token.
04
AugReg 视觉 TransformerAugReg vision Transformer
在完整体数据序列上做多头自注意力。CLS 与所有区域标记双向交换信息，在多层中聚合扫描级结构；这里不是逐切片独立编码后再做层级注意力。Multi-head self-attention operates on the full volume sequence. CLS exchanges information with all regional tokens and aggregates scan-level structure across layers; this is not independent per-slice encoding followed by hierarchical attention.
05
图像投影与归一化Image projection and normalization
取最后一层归一化后的 CLS 输出，再以线性头映射到共享维度。Base 为 768 维；计算对比相似度前做 L2 归一化，使内积对应余弦相似度。Take the final normalized CLS output and project it linearly into the shared space, 768 dimensions for Base. L2 normalization before contrastive similarity makes the dot product a cosine similarity.
06
报告文本编码Report text encoding
另一条并行路径将报告分词并提供注意力掩码，送入 CXR-BERT-specialized。固定语言塔取第一个标记的最终隐状态，再通过线性投影与对应视觉变体对齐。A parallel path tokenizes the report, supplies an attention mask and encodes it with CXR-BERT-specialized. The pinned language tower takes the first-token final hidden state and linearly projects it to the matching vision variant’s shared dimension.
07
批内图文相似度矩阵In-batch image–text similarity
对 B 个扫描与 B 份报告形成 B×B 相似度矩阵。对角线对应真实图文对，其余项是批内负对；分布式训练先汇集多 GPU 特征，扩充对比集合。A batch of B scans and B reports forms a B×B similarity matrix. The diagonal contains matched pairs and off-diagonal entries provide in-batch negatives. Distributed training gathers features across GPUs before constructing the contrastive set.
08
双向对比目标Symmetric contrastive objective
同时优化图像找报告与报告找图像，两个方向的交叉熵取平均。相似度的缩放影响 softmax 锐度；公式的除数温度与代码的乘数缩放须按各自约定解释。Optimize image-to-report and report-to-image matching, averaging cross-entropy in the two directions. Similarity scaling controls softmax sharpness; divisor temperature in the formula and multiplier scale in code must be interpreted under their own conventions.
09
检索与提示词分类Retrieval and prompt classification
推理时可只编码 CT，并与预先编码的报告或“病变存在／不存在”提示比较。图文向量是匹配表示；双编码器本身不逐词生成报告，也不输出分割掩码。At inference, CT embeddings can be compared with pre-encoded reports or pathology-present/pathology-absent prompts. These are matching representations: the dual encoder itself does not generate report tokens or segmentation masks.
10
冻结表征后的任务建模Task models on frozen representations
将图像塔的向量作为独立模型的输入。论文疾病分类使用按解剖视野分别拟合的 L1 逻辑回归，预后使用 ridge Cox 模型；这些拟合目标与图文预训练目标不同。Use vision-tower vectors as inputs to separate models. The paper fits field-of-view-specific L1 logistic regressions for disease classification and ridge Cox models for prognosis. Their fitting objectives differ from image–text pretraining.
上一代瓶颈
  • 窄解剖视野、单一造影条件或单一临床任务上的训练，限制了 CT 表征覆盖真实扫描差异的能力。
  • Training in narrow anatomical windows, contrast settings or clinical tasks limits coverage of real-world CT variation.
核心想法
  • 将全体 CT 的三维视觉编码器与报告文本编码器对齐，让医学报告提供扫描级语义监督。
  • Align a whole-volume 3D vision encoder with a report encoder so that radiology text supplies scan-level semantic supervision.
关键改进
  • 期刊路线以 AugReg ViT 的三维分块与 CXR-BERT-specialized 组成双塔，并在不同视野、造影条件和临床用途的配对数据上统一训练。
  • The journal route pairs a 3D-patch AugReg ViT with CXR-BERT-specialized and trains jointly across fields of view, contrast settings and clinical indications.
医学适配
  • 同一 CT 表征被用于跨模态检索、胸部病变提示词分类、实验室指标关联、疾病分类和纵向风险研究；后几项通过独立统计或预测模型实现。
  • The same CT representation supports retrieval, thoracic prompt classification, laboratory associations, disease classification and longitudinal risk research. The latter uses separate statistical or predictive models.
适用范围与证据
  • 外部 CT-RATE、院内验证及生物学关联回答不同问题。相似度分数、疾病概率与风险排序不可互换，观察性关联也不直接给出因果解释。
  • External CT-RATE validation, internal evaluation and biological association studies answer different questions. Similarity, disease probability and risk rank are not interchangeable, and observational association does not directly establish causality.

设计原理与训练Design and training

  • 三维块包含局部体素关系，完整序列注意力再连接远距离区域。以给定尺寸计算，区域标记数为 (128÷8)×(352÷16)×(352÷16)=7744，加上 CLS 后共 7745；输入分辨率改变会显著改变注意力计算规模。Volumetric patches encode local voxel relationships, while full-sequence attention links distant regions. At the stated size, (128÷8)×(352÷16)×(352÷16)=7,744 regional tokens plus CLS gives 7,745 tokens. Resolution changes can substantially alter attention cost.
  • 两条编码路径在相似度空间相遇，不是在视觉编码中交叉注意全部报告词元。配对监督鼓励扫描与其报告相近，但报告未描述的影像细节不一定得到同等强度监督。The two encoders meet in similarity space rather than cross-attending every report token inside the vision tower. Pair supervision brings a scan closer to its report; details omitted from the report need not receive equally strong supervision.
  • 视觉参数约 6M、22M、86M 仅对应 Tiny、Small、Base 视觉塔。它们的共享空间为 192、384、768 维，不是所有变体都采用 768 维，也不能把视觉参数数目当成双塔总参数。The approximate 6M, 22M and 86M parameter counts refer only to Tiny, Small and Base vision towers. Shared dimensions are 192, 384 and 768. Not every variant is 768-dimensional, and vision-only counts are not two-tower totals.
  • 期刊预训练使用 436,787 个 CT—报告对、51,966 名参与者。配对验证集为 46,535 个体数据、5,774 名参与者；额外无报告验证 CT 用于图像侧下游分析。组合验证队列按论文报告为 123,603 个 CT、20,599 名参与者，不把子组人数直接相加。Journal pretraining uses 436,787 CT–report pairs from 51,966 participants. Paired validation contains 46,535 volumes from 5,774 participants; additional unpaired CT is used for image-side downstream analyses. Use the reported combined validation cohort of 123,603 CT volumes and 20,599 participants rather than summing subgroup participant counts.
  • AdamW、初始学习率 5×10⁻⁵、每 GPU 批量 48、4 张 NVIDIA B200 对应全局有效批量 192。固定 Base YAML 设定 16 个 epoch、clip 损失且不冻结语言塔；这些是所审阅发布配置，不是自选的最优训练建议。AdamW, initial learning rate 5×10⁻⁵, per-GPU batch size 48 and four NVIDIA B200 GPUs yield a global batch size of 192. The pinned Base YAML sets 16 epochs, clip loss and an unfrozen language tower. These are reviewed release settings, not independently optimized recommendations.
  • 本页公式采用标准除数温度 τ 的对称对比目标。期刊文字记 τ=10；固定代码的 CLIP 分支在未启用可学习缩放时把余弦相似度乘 10，若启用则使用 exp(logit_scale)。这两种写法不应被直接说成同一个数值温度。The formula here uses the standard divisor-temperature τ convention. Journal prose states τ=10; the pinned CLIP branch instead multiplies cosine similarity by 10 when learnable scaling is disabled, or uses exp(logit_scale) when enabled. The numerical conventions should not be equated without conversion.
  • 本文以 2026 年期刊 Article in Press 与固定 v2 实现解释机制。首次预印本于 2025-07-03 公开，期刊于 2026-09-29 发表；早期 v1 的 DeiT、Clinical Longformer、粗块尺寸和 512 维表示不套用到本页 v2。The explanation follows the 2026 journal Article in Press and pinned v2 implementation. The first preprint appeared on 2025-07-03; the journal article appeared on 2026-09-29. Earlier v1 choices—DeiT, Clinical Longformer, coarse patches and 512-dimensional features—are not attributed to this v2 route.
  • 复现应同时固定物理间隔、轴顺序、空间裁剪、分块尺寸、所选双塔和投影维度，并按参与者划分数据。图像嵌入归一化与分类器的特征标准化是不同操作，要按具体下游协议处理。Reproduction should pin physical spacing, axis order, crop, patch size, tower choice and projection dimension, with participant-level splitting. Image-embedding L2 normalization and classifier feature standardization are distinct operations governed by the downstream protocol.

医学用途与适用范围Medical use and scope

  • 跨模态检索比较 CT 与报告的共享向量；提示词分类比较同一病变的存在与不存在描述。它们使用文本相似度，不等同于已经校准的临床患病概率。Cross-modal retrieval compares CT and report vectors; prompt classification compares present/absent descriptions of one pathology. Both use text similarity rather than an already calibrated clinical disease probability.
  • 论文外部 CT-RATE 验证保留每个检查一个 CT，共 1,564 个体数据、18 类胸部标签，并区分零样本提示词分类与在 CT-RATE 训练数据上另拟合的线性探测。External CT-RATE evaluation retains one CT per study, totaling 1,564 volumes and 18 thoracic labels. It distinguishes zero-shot prompts from linear probes separately fitted on CT-RATE training data.
  • 疾病分类按胸部、腹部／盆腔分别拟合 L1 逻辑回归，使用影像时间附近的疾病状态；纵向预后则以基线之前无对应诊断者为对象，拟合 ridge Cox 风险模型。二者的队列和目标不同。Disease classification fits L1 logistic regression separately for chest and abdomen/pelvis fields of view, targeting disease status near imaging. Longitudinal prognosis instead excludes prior diagnoses of the target condition and fits ridge Cox models. Their cohorts and objectives differ.
  • 实验室指标关联和疾病表型分析使用从训练集拟合的 PCA 坐标，并在验证人群中开展发现与复现。统计显著的坐标关联帮助研究表征，但不意味着某个潜变量就是一个独立生物学机制。Laboratory and disease-phenotype association analyses use PCA axes fitted on training embeddings and discovery–replication analyses in validation participants. Significant associations help characterize representations without identifying each latent coordinate as an independent biological mechanism.
  • 期刊中的合成实验室数值来自额外三层 MLP，输入完整图像表征及影像与化验的时间差，用被试分组交叉验证；它不是双塔预训练自动输出的检验报告。Synthetic laboratory values in the paper come from an additional three-layer MLP using complete image features and the imaging-to-assay time difference, evaluated with subject-grouped cross-validation. They are not test reports automatically produced by dual-encoder pretraining.
  • PMBB 的病例来源、影像视野和造影方式影响表征及验证范围。代码和已发布模型的可获取性，与原始患者影像、报告及生物库数据的访问条件分别处理。PMBB case mix, field of view and contrast administration affect the learned representation and evaluation scope. Availability of code or released models is distinct from access conditions for original patient CT, reports and biobank data.
计算机制Computation

核心公式Core formula

sij=ziI⋅zjT∥ziI∥∥zjT∥τ,L=−12B∑i=1B[log⁡esii∑j=1Besij+log⁡esii∑j=1Besji] s_{ij}=\frac{z_i^{I}\cdot z_j^{T}}{\lVert z_i^{I}\rVert\lVert z_j^{T}\rVert\tau},\qquad \mathcal{L}= -\frac{1}{2B}\sum_{i=1}^{B}\left[\log\frac{e^{s_{ii}}}{\sum_{j=1}^{B}e^{s_{ij}}}+\log\frac{e^{s_{ii}}}{\sum_{j=1}^{B}e^{s_{ji}}}\right]

原文核对与出处Primary-source notes

  1. 期刊架构Journal architecture · E1

    期刊第 11 页描述 AugReg ViT 的三维分块、7744 个区域标记、CLS 与 CXR-BERT-specialized 双塔。Journal page 11 describes 3D-patch AugReg ViT, 7,744 regional tokens, CLS and the CXR-BERT-specialized dual encoder.

    查看原文位置View source location ↗
  2. 固定 Base 配置Pinned Base configuration · E1

    固定 YAML 指定投影维度 768，DHW 块 8×16×16、XYZ 输入 352×352×128、AugReg Base、CXR-BERT-specialized、clip 损失与 16 个 epoch。The pinned YAML specifies dimension 768, DHW patches 8×16×16, XYZ input 352×352×128, AugReg Base, CXR-BERT-specialized, clip loss and 16 epochs.

    查看原文位置View source location ↗
  3. 体数据计算路径Volumetric computation · E1

    固定视觉塔用三维卷积替换二维分块、加入三维位置、前置 CLS，执行完整 Transformer 块，再取归一化 CLS 线性投影。The pinned vision tower replaces 2D patching with a 3D convolution, adds 3D positions and CLS, executes full Transformer blocks, then projects the normalized CLS output.

    查看原文位置View source location ↗
  4. 文本计算路径Text computation · E1

    固定语言塔的 CXR-BERT 配置使用首标记池化及线性层，输出与选定视觉变体相同的共享维度。The pinned CXR-BERT language configuration uses first-token pooling and a linear layer to match the selected vision variant’s shared dimension.

    查看原文位置View source location ↗
  5. 双向训练目标Bidirectional training objective · E1

    实现先对图文向量归一化，ClipLoss 对两个方向交叉熵取平均；分布式场景汇集多卡特征。The implementation normalizes image/text features, averages cross-entropy in both directions and gathers multi-GPU features for distributed contrastive loss.

    查看原文位置View source location ↗
  6. 温度记法Temperature convention · E1

    期刊的除数温度文字与固定代码的乘数缩放约定不同；本页仅给出明确定义的对称目标，不据此声称逐数值训练复现。Journal divisor-temperature prose and the pinned implementation’s multiplier scale use different conventions. This page defines the symmetric objective explicitly without claiming a numerically exact training reproduction.

    查看原文位置View source location ↗
  7. 外部评估协议External evaluation protocol · E1

    期刊第 12 页区分 CT-RATE 上的零样本分类与另行训练的线性探测，并报告验证队列为 1564 个 CT、18 类胸部标签。Journal page 12 separates zero-shot classification from separately trained linear probing on CT-RATE, with 1,564 validation CT volumes and 18 thoracic labels.

    查看原文位置View source location ↗
  8. 下游疾病与风险Downstream disease and risk · E1

    第 13 页将疾病分类的 L1 逻辑回归与预后的 ridge Cox 分别拟合，并说明病例定义、队列与验证协议。Page 13 fits L1 logistic classification and ridge Cox prognosis separately and specifies outcome definitions, cohorts and evaluation protocols.
